messages:
ria: Hey — quick sketch: can we simplify route grammar shown in the Console? current mix of host/path/service/header overrides is confusing for new users.
ria: Proposal: surface a small subset in the UI and keep advanced matching in an "advanced" drawer. e.g. show only exact host + path + service, hide header anchors unless toggled.
ana: +1 on reducing noise. But how do we handle existing rules that rely on header anchors? we can’t silently change behavior.
tom: We could add a `strict` flag on routes. strict = true -> exact host+path precedence, strict = false -> legacy header overrides allowed. defaulting is the tricky bit.
lee: Example UI view idea:
lee: ```
{
  host: "api.acme.com",
  path: "/v1/payments/*",
  service: "payments-main",
  strict: true
}
```
sam: I like `strict`. Also we should show a match-simulate panel in the console where you paste a request and see which route matched and why. saves a lot of confusion.
maria: telemetry: please add a `match_reason` label on route metrics (host_exact, host_wildcard, path_prefix, header_anchor, fallback). We can use it to find how often implicit fallbacks fire.
ria: +1 to telemetry. If we add `match_reason` we can surface a warning for routes that relied on header_anchor > path by default.
deploy-bot: deploy: route-grammar-ui v0.3 rolled to staging by @ria — includes strict toggle and match-simulate component :rocket:
tom: UX rollout thought: when enabling strict default for new routes, we should not retroactively change existing ones. Instead add a console prompt: "Enable strict matching by default for new routes?" with an audit log entry.
ana: For API semantics: gateways still need deterministic precedence. propose explicit precedence doc: host exact > host wildcard > path exact > path prefix length desc > header anchors > service alias > global fallback.
lee: Agree, but header anchors are high-cost to compute. If we demote them in UI, we should also ensure runtime short-circuits before header checks to save cycles.
sam: quota interactions: if a route becomes stricter and sends traffic elsewhere, quota usage shifts — we need per-route quota snapshots in rollouts so infra & SRE can see impact.
maria: Also add a small alert rule template: if match_reason changes > 20% after rollout, notify owner.
ria: Ok action items:
ria: 1) write a short RFC for `strict` flag + precedence table (tom + me)
ria: 2) console changes: hide header anchors behind advanced, add match-simulate (lee)
ria: 3) telemetry: add `match_reason` label and rollout-change alert (maria)
ria: 4) rollout UX: prompt for new default strict setting and non-retroactive (ana + tom)
ria: 5) perf: ensure header checks short-circuit (eng-runtime)
sam: I'll add quota snapshot to the rollout checklist.
maria: I'll draft the alert template and dashboard widget for match_reason.
ria: Thanks all. tagging @eng-runtime for perf follow-up. :thumbsup:
